# Vincent Hamel, CPA

> Montreal-based finance and management advisor (CPA) offering fractional CFO services to small and mid-sized companies ($5M to $100M in revenue, 50 to 1,000 employees): financing, governance, processes, strategy and growth, plus transactions and turnaround. Data-driven decisions guided by business judgment. Works in French and English, in Quebec, Canada and the United States.

## Key facts
- Over 15 years leading finance, financing, governance and operations for companies with $5M to $100M in revenue and 50 to 1,000 employees.
- Chief Financial Officer of Felix & Paul Studios (Emmy-recognized immersive entertainment studio, NASA partner) from 2022 to 2026.
- VP Finance and Administration, previously Finance and Administration Director and Partner, at Sid Lee (global creative agency), 2011 to 2022.
- Auditor at Mazars Harel Drouin, 2006 to 2011.
- CPA; HEC Montréal (BBA in Accounting, Graduate Diploma in Public Accounting).
- Board member and Chair of the Finance, Audit and Investment Committee, Cystic Fibrosis Canada; board member, POP Montreal.
- Secured and structured over $20M in financing; led a cross-border team of 90 people.

## Services
- Strategic advisor and fractional CFO
- Financing and lender relations
- Transactions, buyouts and succession
- Turnaround and restructuring
- Governance, processes and systems
- Operations and growth

Engagement formats: project mandate, ongoing advisory (for example one day a week), interim.

## FAQ
### What is a fractional CFO?
An experienced chief financial officer who works with your company a few days a month or a week, depending on your needs. You get the judgment and network of an executive-level CFO without the cost of a full-time position.

### What kind of companies do you work with?
Small and mid-sized companies, from $5M to $100M in revenue and from 50 to 1,000 employees, in any sector. I know the creative industries, entertainment, culture, agencies, architecture and design, and non-profits particularly well.

### How does a first engagement work?
It starts with a 30-minute conversation, with no commitment, to understand your situation. I then send you a written engagement proposal that sets out the objectives, timeline, my role and fees.

### Can you support a financing or transaction from start to finish?
Yes. I prepare the file, the financial model and the strategy, take part in negotiations with lenders, investors or buyers, and coordinate lawyers and tax advisors through to closing.

### Do you work in English and French, and remotely?
Yes, in both languages. I am based in Montreal and work on site or remotely with companies in Quebec, elsewhere in Canada and in the United States.
